# Modify Global Variable At Index

Source: [4394](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4394); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Modify Global Variable At Index](../../api/actions/modify-global-variable-at-index.md).
